question: Table tennis made its Olympic debut in ______ Olympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seoul Olympics**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• Table tennis made its **Olympic debut** during the **1988 Seoul Olympics**. 
• The sport was included in both **men's and women's events**, featuring singles and doubles competitions. 
• The inclusion of table tennis in the Olympics was a result of its growing popularity worldwide, particularly in **Asian countries** such as China, Japan, and South Korea. 
• Since its debut in Seoul, table tennis has become one of the most competitive sports in the Olympics, with **China dominating the medal tally** in subsequent games. 
• The governing body of table tennis, the **International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF)**, played a significant role in advocating for its inclusion in the Olympic program. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Historical Background:** 
• Table tennis originated in **England** during the late 19th century as an indoor version of lawn tennis. 
• It became a competitive sport with standardized rules in the early 20th century and spread globally. 
• **Features of Table Tennis:** 
• It is played on a rectangular table divided by a net, with players using paddles to hit a lightweight ball. 
• The game requires **precision, agility, and quick reflexes**. 
• **Olympic Success:** 
• China is the most successful nation in Olympic table tennis history, having won the majority of gold medals since 1988. 
• Other countries such as South Korea, Germany, and Sweden have also performed well in Olympic table tennis events. 
• **Key Milestones:** 
• The International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) was founded in **1926**, establishing global rules and competitions. 
• The World Table Tennis Championships began in the same year, showcasing international talent. 
• Table tennis was officially recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in the **1980s**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **China’s Dominance:** 
• China has won **28 out of 32 gold medals** awarded in table tennis since its inclusion in the Olympics. 
• Top Chinese players such as **Ma Long**, **Deng Yaping**, and **Li Xiaoxia** are celebrated for their Olympic achievements. 
• **Olympic Events:** 
• Table tennis includes singles and team events for both men and women. 
• The mixed doubles event was added to the Olympic program in the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**. 
• **Growth of the Sport:** 
• Table tennis is now played in **over 200 countries**, with millions of players worldwide. 
• The game has advanced technologically, with improvements in paddles, balls, and playing surfaces.
